coverage_rule.prereg_text: 7. **Own-grid coverage gate:** share of valid, finite vertices in the patch of the cut grid with rows at W's z range and columns within ± 5.85 mm (arc length) of the seed column. **< 0.70 → KILL without a read** (TOL-HOLES: 30 % holes did not read). A fit that crashes is engineering; a fit that runs and returns NaN / leaves the patch counts against coverage.
coverage_rule.result: KILL without a read: the seed's patch lies ~12 windings inward of the seed; only 0.046 of its vertices are within one winding pitch of the seed's radius (< 0.70). The Judge applied the written rule ('leaves the patch counts against coverage'), not the coded gate (1.0).
